Every [B]Settlement[/B] a leader gains, loses or upgrades.[NN][BLIST][LI][B]Pin[/B]: gold for a City, blue for a Town[LI][B]Dot[/B]: Founded (or Incorporated), Captured, Lost, Razed or Upgraded to City[LI][B]Dashed Arc[/B]: joins a Town to its upgrade, and a capture or loss to the razing[/LIST][NN][B]Total[/B]: Settlements held now (or at the end of the Age).[N][B]Card[/B]: Cities and Towns.

Every citizen a leader's Settlements gain.[NN][BLIST][LI][B]Pin[/B]: the building or improvement that added it, in the colour of its main yield[LI][B]Dot[/B]: gold for urban, silver for rural[LI][B]Specialist[/B]: a glowing gold pin, with the buildings on its tile[/LIST][NN]A captured Settlement counts from its size when taken.[NN][B]Total[/B]: population (urban, rural and specialists on hover).[N][B]Card[/B]: specialists, by settlement and quarter on hover.

Every unit a leader [B]produced[/B], [B]purchased[/B] or was [B]granted[/B].[NN][BLIST][LI][B]Pin[/B]: land, naval, civilian or commander[LI][B]Commanders[/B]: counted once, not again when they return after defeat[/LIST][NN][B]Total[/B]: units trained, by category on hover.[N][B]Card[/B]: each commander type trained, else the most trained unit.

Every unit a leader lost to another player, killed or captured.[NN][BLIST][LI][B]Pin[/B]: land, naval, civilian or commander, with who took it[LI][B]Rank[/B]: fewest lost first[/LIST][NN][B]Total[/B]: units lost, by category on hover.[N][B]Card[/B]: each commander type lost, else the most lost unit.

Every unit of another player a leader killed or captured.[NN][BLIST][LI][B]Pin[/B]: land, naval, civilian or commander, with whose it was[/LIST][NN][B]Total[/B]: units defeated, by category on hover.[N][B]Card[/B]: each commander type defeated, else the most defeated unit.

Every [B]Promotion[/B] and [B]Commendation[/B] a leader's commanders earn.[NN][BLIST][LI][B]Promotion[/B]: its tree's icon, on a pin in the tree's colour[LI][B]Commendation[/B]: its icon, on a glowing gold pin[LI][B]Detail[/B]: the commander and which of its promotions it was[/LIST][NN]A dashed arc joins each commander's promotions; the dot's colour tells commanders apart.[NN][B]Total[/B]: Promotions and Commendations.[N][B]Card[/B]: the most earned Commendation, then the most promoted tree; each Commendation and tree on hover.

Wars between leaders; Independent Powers are always hostile and don't count. The notches show each turn:[NN][BLIST][LI][B]Red[/B]: Aggression, the leader declared the war[LI][B]Yellow[/B]: Defense, war was declared on the leader[LI][B]Grey[/B]: At Peace[/LIST][NN]Wars going on at once share a notch; a peace made fills its notch in green. A pin of the enemy marks where each war began, and a [B]green[/B] pin where peace was made; each names who attacked whom.[NN][B]Turns[/B]: turns at war.[N][B]Card[/B]: the enemy it was at war with longest (each when tied), every war on hover. A war goes on into a new Age until peace.

A leader's conflicts, in order of priority:[NN][BLIST][LI][B]Razed[/B]: a Settlement razed, once gone from the map[LI][B]Captured[/B]: a Settlement taken[LI][B]Lost[/B]: a Settlement taken from the leader[LI][B]Siege[/B]: a Settlement besieged; besieged again by the same enemy within 5 turns, it is the same siege[LI][B]Battle[/B]: an engagement with 3 or more attacks or 4 or more pillage, on its first turn or once it has lasted 3 turns, or fighting on 5 turns, or a siege between the two sides[LI][B]Skirmish[/B]: an engagement with less[LI][B]Pillaged[/B]: a tile pillaged[/LIST][NN]A dot shows who it was against: gold for a leader, blue for a City-State, silver for an Independent Power. A pin leads with a leader, then a City-State, then an Independent Power. The notches show each siege (orange), battle (red) and skirmish (blue) while it goes on; where they meet they share the notch, the first of them taking most of it.[NN]An [B]engagement[/B] is every attack and pillage between the same two sides within 3 tiles, with no more than 5 turns between them. It only counts once both sides have attacked each other with units that can fight (not settlers or scouts), and each attack counts for both sides; pillage is 2 for a building, 1 for a rural tile. A dashed arc joins each to what it followed from: a Skirmish to the Battle it became, the fighting to a Siege, a Siege to a capture or loss, and that to the razing. [B]Was Pillaged[/B] (its own tiles) counts too, under [B]Pillaged[/B]. Only pillaging by enemy units counts, not floods, eruptions or storms.[NN][B]Total[/B]: sieges, battles, skirmishes and pillage; razings, captures and losses are their outcomes, shown apart on hover.[N][B]Card[/B]: the Nemesis, the player fought most (leaders before City-States and Independent Powers); every other opponent on hover.
When each leader lost units to destruction or capture, and to whom.
When each leader trained or bought units, and which.
